posts.title: Dining Philosophers as a coding problem
posts.description: I did two coding problems from the practice-go repo recently, static function call frequency and reversing substrings inside parentheses . These problems did not emphasize the particulars of Go much, although the static function frequency problem did use Go standard library packages that are otherwise not very approachable.

posts.title: Bash Shell Dining Philosophers
posts.description: I did the famous Dining Philosophers problem in bash shell script. I did a resource hierarchy solution. It looks like someone named “leahgard” did the far more ambitious Dijkstra’s solution in bash .
